text:
nina: noticed sporadic JSON.parse failures in sampleapp-js streaming. repro: quick network blip during auth refresh. browser fetch-based SSE.

paul: any raw output? curl -N?

nina: yes, curl shows chunk boundary like:

: keepalive
data: {"id":"A"}

\r\n
{"id":"B"}


which gets treated as continuation so parser ends up with '\n{"id":...' appended to previous data and JSON.parse fails.

omar: likely proxy/TCP coalescing + our abort/reconnect timing. SDK currently splits on "\n\n" only. we should normalize CRLF first, ignore ":" keepalive lines, and drop partial buffer on abort.

nina: implemented small fix: buffer = buffer.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n"); discard partial on abort; only parse lines starting with 'data:'. quick run reduces failures from ~5% to ~0.4%.

paul: add metric for parse_errors with tag reconnect=true. also check edge config (haproxy/nginx) for buffering/coalescing.

ci-bot: branch fix/sse-crlf-normalize CI: 8/8 checks passed. :white_check_mark:

nina: filing PR and follow-ups: @omar check edge flags; @paul add metric; will backport to 0.9.x if green. gist with repro attached (internal).
